conditions.background: Normal app indexing, watcher, watchdog and sidecar; Ollama deliberately unreachable at loopback discard port; desktop sleep/idle inhibited
conditions.polling: Ordinary editor save IPC attempted every 250 ms; at most one pending save. Independent read-only Syncthing folder-state reads every 100 ms plus request time. Probes cover 2 seconds before boundary through four post-terminal saves.
conditions.firstSyncLimit: Replicas were seeded independently before their first synchronization. Both terminal outcomes succeeded and expected canonical bodies arrived, with 26 additional conflict copies per replica retained unresolved. This measurement includes that conflict-copy workload; it is not a clean steady-state sync benchmark.

method.leaseAcquisition: BulkMutationCoordinator::acquire locks note_mutation before resume; run_sync retains lease through backup, transfer, handoff, folder/device pause and projection reconciliation. Drop precedes sync-done emission.
method.handoff: hold_for_peer_handoff permits 60 seconds after convergence, ending early on peer disconnect; exact entry/exit are not logged.
method.startBounds: Scheduled work cannot start before hourly boundary; first observed unpaused folder necessarily follows lease acquisition. This is a bracket, not an instrumented lock/start timestamp.
method.durationBounds: Lower: terminal event receipt minus first unpaused response. Upper: terminal event receipt minus boundary. Both include terminal-delivery overhead.
method.leaseBounds: Lower: last unpaused request minus first unpaused response. Upper: terminal event receipt minus boundary. No product instrumentation added.
method.saveLatency: Monotonic performance.now interval from ordinary save_note_or_preserve invocation to successful response, with wall-clock endpoints. Latency includes waiting plus IPC, durable write and projection work. Baselines are empirical, not a certified upper bound on overhead.
method.probePerturbation: Each probe saves unchanged body to its own distinct fixture note and updates modified time/history. One pending save maximum. Post-release probe metadata need not replicate until the next batch; verification checks body markers and additions, not byte equality of probe files.
method.privacy: Public fields selected explicitly; no hostnames, device IDs, IPs, private paths, credentials, screenshots or note content.
